validity.description: Synthetic fractions selected to produce transparent mass-balance arithmetic across four named compartments.

sources.citation: Wendt, Regine (2024), Einsatz von Nanotechnologien in der Präzisionsmedizin, Section 4.4, p. 127
sources.role: blood, endothelium, interstitium, and cell exchange architecture

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M4.5 balanced capillary exchange contract, version 1.0.0
sources.role: synthetic fractions, staged partition semantics, and balance invariant

limitations: All fractions are synthetic software-test values and are not physiological oxygen-exchange parameters.
The partition is instantaneous at capillary-region exit and does not model diffusion time, concentration gradients, membrane area, or permeability.
Transfer is one-way for this increment; release, reverse exchange, metabolism, and clearance are not represented.
Unmatched substances pass through unchanged and require their own evidence-scoped rules before biological use.
